name: Alex Mercer
baseline_profile: High aerobic capacity, vagal dominance, low resting HR (52 bpm), stable baseline.
clinical_summary: Elite triathlete with exceptional autonomic regulation, low biological noise, and high cardiovascular resilience.

name: Marcus Vance
baseline_profile: Stable for days 1-45; progressive sleep debt and sympathetic escalation days 46-90.
clinical_summary: Senior executive experiencing chronic workplace stress, gradual resting tachycardia (+14 bpm), and systolic blood pressure elevation.

name: Elena Rostova
baseline_profile: Acute post-viral autonomic fatigue early (days 1-35) with steady 55-day restorative trajectory.
clinical_summary: Post-viral dysautonomia patient showing steady normalization of resting heart rate and spontaneous activity rebound.

name: Dr. David Chen
baseline_profile: High physical exertion (15,000+ steps) combined with severe sleep deprivation (<5.2h).
clinical_summary: Surgical resident and marathoner showing acute autonomic nervous system exhaustion, elevated resting HR, and impaired recovery readiness.

name: Sarah Jenkins
baseline_profile: Healthy baseline with sudden subclinical capillary oxygen dip (98.5% -> 94.8%) days 60-75.
clinical_summary: Early subclinical viral pneumonitis presentation where subtle SpO2 drift and compensatory tachycardia precede overt symptoms by 4 days.

name: Michael Thorne
baseline_profile: Low physical step count (<3,800 steps) with steady vascular remodeling and systolic BP drift (122 -> 142 mmHg).
clinical_summary: Sedentary desk worker presenting with progressive arterial stiffness, creeping blood pressure, and metabolic deceleration.

name: Chloe Ramirez
baseline_profile: Rotating 7-day night shift cycle with acute circadian phase shift and fragmented sleep architecture.
clinical_summary: ICU charge nurse showing periodic autonomic instability, high sleep duration variance (4h to 9h), and intermittent stress spikes.

name: Arthur Pendelton
baseline_profile: Age-adjusted cardiovascular baseline: resting HR 74 bpm, SBP 136 mmHg, reduced elasticity.
clinical_summary: Geriatric patient with essential hypertension and mild left ventricular hypertrophy, sensitive to medication timing and weather.

name: Margaret Holloway
baseline_profile: Age-adjusted baseline: low daily activity (2,600 steps), blunted autonomic responsiveness.
clinical_summary: Elderly patient with mild frailty syndrome, monitored for sudden micro-drops in mobility and orthostatic hemodynamic strain.

name: Vikram Patel
baseline_profile: Progressive drop in daily steps (6,500 down to 2,800) alongside elevated stress and nighttime HR elevation.
clinical_summary: Early metabolic syndrome cohort exhibiting chronic low-grade sympathetic activation and progressive lifestyle deconditioning.

name: Rachel Adams
baseline_profile: High baseline strain days 1-30; intentional lifestyle rehabilitation days 31-90.
clinical_summary: Successful lifestyle intervention participant achieving 28-point risk score reduction through structured sleep hygiene and brisk walking.

name: Jordan Lee
baseline_profile: Sedentary lifestyle (5,200 steps), but healthy diet, low stress (18/100), and stable cardiovascular metrics.
clinical_summary: Control subject with low physical activity but high autonomic stability and normal baseline homeostasis.
